goal: The assistant must behave as a company-level shared service: multiple employees can start independent first-message chats concurrently without one user's route, plugin side effect, or session state breaking another user's reply path.

rules.title: Concurrent first messages must complete
rules.text: A local runtime smoke test with multiple distinct users and sessions must return HTTP 200 and a completed SSE response for every first message.

rules.title: Reliability gates precede feature activation
rules.text: New router, workflow, memory, and skill frameworks must pass the first-message smoke before being enabled beyond observe-only mode.

rules.title: No shared-session contamination
rules.text: Smoke traffic must use distinct usernames and session IDs. Failures include cross-user session reuse, database lock failures, dropped streams, and incomplete responses.

rules.title: Side-effect plugins must fail open
rules.text: Inbox, employee insight, onboarding, memory, and knowledge-base enrichment plugins may annotate or persist side effects, but slow or failing side-effect work must time out or degrade without blocking the primary chat response path.

rules.title: Grey features must not auto-enroll normal chat
rules.text: Employee-facing grey features may accept explicit self-registration or pre-approved pilot profiles, but ordinary first messages from unknown users must remain observe-only by default.

acceptance_tests.title: Five concurrent local first messages complete through the real OpenAPI path
AI Inbox side effects time out without blocking message handling
Employee insight defaults to pilot-only observe mode and times out fail-open
Concierge KB enrichment times out without blocking LLM request preparation
Employee onboarding times out without blocking business first messages

operator_notes: This smoke test calls the live local API server on http://127.0.0.1:6185 and may trigger the configured LLM provider.
It does not send Feishu messages and creates only a temporary local OpenAPI key when ASTRBOT_API_KEY is not already configured.
